stories.title: Author pom.xml with Red Hat Quarkus BOM, extensions, and directory structure
acceptance_criteria: pom.xml imports com.redhat.quarkus.platform BOM 3.27.3.SP1 and declares quarkus-rest, quarkus-rest-jackson extensions
mvn -q compile succeeds with Java 21 toolchain

stories.title: Migrate GET /greeting to Quarkus REST with Jackson
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/greeting returns 200 with JSON {"id": long, "content": "Hello, World!"}
GET /api/greeting?name=Alice returns 200 with JSON {"id": long, "content": "Hello, Alice!"}
Sequential requests increment the id field
mvn -q test passes with GreetingResourceTest verifying all scenarios
